title: Examining macroeconomic determinants of stock market performance: evidence from Saudi Arabia
core_idea: Investigate how key macroeconomic variables (GDP, inflation, FDI, trade balance, government expenditure) influence Saudi Arabia's stock market by applying Johansen cointegration tests and a vector error correction model to capture long- and short-run dynamics over a multi-decade period, with the goal of informing policy during economic diversification under Vision 2030.
tldr: Uses cointegration and VECM to analyze the relationships between major macroeconomic factors and Saudi stock market performance to provide empirical guidance for policymakers and investors amid economic diversification objectives.
